$schema_note: INFRA-001 deliverable — the audited state inventory of the Offisos web host and shared app shell, classified into the five categories. Revision-bound to the audited main (a9867a8, branch point of work/infra-001-persistent-serverless-foundation). File paths are repository-relative; line anchors reference the audited revision.

A_authoritative_persistent.description: State that must survive every request, instance rotation and process death, and is the authority for its domain. Target: Neon PostgreSQL (registry/transactional) + Cloudflare R2 (immutable content-addressed bodies).

items.name: CADDocument versioned content (the editor working representation)
items.location: app/src/caddocument/document.ts (class CADDocument); live copy in AppApiHandler.doc (app/src/app-api/contract.ts:575)
items.current_store: Instance memory only between checkpoints; autosave checkpoint blobs (content-addressed) through the P016 store; client-side file download on SAVE
items.contents: elements, layers, ltypes, textStyles, dimStyles, layerStates, blockDefs, xrefs, constraints, layouts, viewports, ucs, sectionPlanes, navigatorNodes, titleBlocks, schedules, propertyDefs, specialized, revisions, publisherSets, docsViews, docsSheets, ifcImports, draftingSettings, bimSettings, sourceArtifactLineage, version (VersionMeta), modelHistory (immutable append-only)
items.identity: version.entity_id (document entity id — the P016 project key today); version.version_id deterministic from content hash; element ids document-owned deterministic
items.target_store: Neon: document registry + append-only version chain; R2: content-addressed version bodies

items.name: Model revision history (immutable, append-only)
items.location: app/src/caddocument/history.ts (ModelHistory); persisted inside CADDocumentSnapshot.modelHistory
items.current_store: Travels with the snapshot (payload-carried); verifiedReplay proves determinism
items.target_store: R2 (with the version body) + Neon registry rows (revision numbers, hashes) for indexed lookup

items.name: P016 project event log (collab/recovery/jobs/automation)
items.location: app/src/persist/index.ts (P016Persist port); apps/web/src/server/p016-postgres.ts; apps/web/src/server/p016-blob.ts; app/src/persist/file.ts
items.current_store: CI: postgres (p016_events/p016_blobs, advisory-lock serialization); Electron: file; production: FAIL-CLOSED (no secrets configured — typed p016_persistence_unconfigured)
items.contents: clock, collab (members/presence/comments/activity/transactions/merge lineage), recovery (checkpoint index + nextSeq), jobs (records/seq/tickCount), automation (principals/scripts/runs/subscriptions/extensions)
items.target_store: Neon (authoritative transactional; promote the proven CI schema); blobs to R2

items.name: Recovery checkpoints (durable versioned snapshots)
items.location: app/src/recovery/index.ts (CheckpointStore); minted by AppApiHandler.mintCheckpoint (autosave policy DEFAULT_RECOVERY_POLICY)
items.current_store: Content-addressed blobs in the P016 store; index in the P016 record; restore proven from a fresh handler (restart-proof CI evidence)
items.target_store: R2 (blobs/<sha>.json semantics preserved); index rows in Neon

items.name: Job records (durable stepwise state machine)
items.location: app/src/jobs/index.ts (JobStore — create/tick/terminal); persisted in the P016 record's jobs section
items.current_store: P016 store (same fail-closed production state as ST-A03)
items.contents: id, kind (docs.regenerate | quantity.recalculate | model.stream.warm), status, step/totalSteps, params, work (per-step deterministic working state), result summary with revisionBinding, failure
items.target_store: Neon jobs table with claim lease + attempts; result artifacts to R2; executor ticks from the worker service (INFRA-006) or client ticks (today)

items.name: Command + idempotency records (proposed)
items.location: not yet implemented — today idempotency is instance-local (see ST-C01); commands are not journaled server-side
items.target_store: Neon: idempotency_keys (unique (scope,key) → persisted response binding) + command log rows (audit + replay evidence)

B_persistent_artifacts.description: Immutable, content-addressed or provenance-preserved artifacts. Target: Cloudflare R2 (S3-compatible) with the content-addressed discipline already proven by the P016 blob adapter.

items.name: Checkpoint snapshot blobs

C_ephemeral_coordination.description: Transient, recomputable, or derivable state. Target: Upstash Redis with documented key patterns, TTLs, authority sources, failure behavior and rebuild strategies. Redis is NEVER authoritative (spec/architecture.md §6).

items.name: Idempotency cache
items.location: app/src/app-api/idempotency.ts (IdempotencyCache — LRU, 1024 entries, in-process)
items.defect: Instance-local: the same idempotencyKey on a second instance re-executes the command (duplicate execution under retry/rotation)
items.target: Redis idem:{scope}:{key} as a READ-THROUGH cache (TTL 24h) over the Neon idempotency table (ST-A06, the authority); on Redis loss the authority still dedups

items.name: Collaboration presence/liveness
items.location: app/src/collab/index.ts (presence beats, deterministic project-clock TTL) — durably recorded in the P016 record; the web UI polls
items.target: Redis presence:{projectKey}:{userId} (TTL = PRESENCE_TTL) for low-latency liveness reads; the durable P016 record remains the timeline authority; Redis loss degrades to P016-record reads

items.name: Model stream cache pages (large-model streaming)
items.location: app/src/modelstream/index.ts (ModelStreamCache — version-keyed, non-authoritative, revalidated against the current canonical version)
items.target: Redis cache:stream:{documentId}:{version}:{page} with the existing non-authority contract (stale entries evicted with exact accounting, never served); rebuild = recompute from the authoritative snapshot

items.name: Tessellation cache (revision-tied LOD meshes)
items.location: AppApiHandler.tessellationCache (bounded, descriptor+quality keyed, dual budgets)
items.target: Redis index + R2 bodies (ST-B05) for cross-instance reuse; every entry keyed by canonical descriptor encoding — an edit that changes geometry naturally invalidates

items.name: Engine availability probe memoization
items.location: apps/web/src/app/api/cad/route.ts (probeOcctEngine once per handler instance, 15s budget)
items.target: Redis probe:engine:{engineId} (TTL ~60s) so cold instances skip the probe cost; authority = the probe itself (recomputable)

items.name: Short-lived coordination locks (proposed)
items.location: not needed today (postgres advisory locks / blob create-if-absent already serialize appends)
items.target: Redis lock:doc:{entityId} with lease TTL ONLY as an optimization layer over the Neon CAS serialization point; a lost lock never corrupts state (the CAS still decides)

E_worker_state.description: State living in engine/worker execution contexts. Process-per-call today; the persistent worker service (INFRA-006) keeps workers stateless-per-call with durable coordination through the job records.

items.name: OCCT worker processes (geometry realization)
items.location: app/src/adapters/occt/occt-process.ts (process-per-call: spawn python, 15s wall-clock, 64MiB stdout cap, prlimit address-space ceiling)
items.note: Stateless per call; target: the persistent worker service fronts the same JSON stdio protocol over HTTP claim/execute

items.name: IFC worker processes (IfcOpenShell 0.8.5)
items.location: app/src/adapters/ifc/ifc-process.ts (disposable per-op worker; typed ifc_unavailable when the toolchain is absent — the serverless production boundary today)
items.note: Target: runs in the worker service where the pinned toolchain is installed

items.name: Job execution working state (per-step work records)
items.location: app/src/jobs/index.ts JobRecord.work/workMut (deterministic, accumulated across ticks, persisted in the P016 record between steps)
items.note: The durable-tick design already survives executor restarts; the worker service becomes an additional ticker (claim lease + heartbeat), not a stateful owner

cross_cutting_observations: The production deployment (PR #133 evidence) runs with NO external secrets: DATABASE_URL and BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN are unset, so createP016Persist() resolves to FailClosedP016Persist and every P016 command declines typed — the durable layer is CI-proven but not production-wired.

The AppApiHandler singleton (route.ts:172 handlerPromise) is the ONLY holder of the live document: the multi-instance divergence, the cold-instance empty document, the instance-local idempotency and the payload-carried SAVE/OPEN are all the same root cause — state placement, not a missing feature.

The P016 port proves the correct discipline already (append = serialization point, pure transitions, content-addressed blobs, fail-closed, byte-identical across backends): the document persistence model extends this precedent rather than inventing a new one.

The engine boundary is serverless-honest today (reference fallback with per-element geometryEngine provenance; typed ifc_unavailable), so the worker service is an additive capability unlock, not a correctness fix.

No auth/tenancy exists in the app (userId is a payload field): the store namespace reserves tenants/default and the security model documents the honest single-tenant phase-1 boundary (LOCK-009 enforcement deferred to the auth work item).
